$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Home section's Chief Permission Mode row (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

rows.name: mode
rows.note: The permission mode the Chief's own Claude turns run in (cmux#37392: "there is no way for me to switch this to dangerously-skip-permissions? ... it should be default on that right?"). Bypass (Claude Code's bypassPermissions) by default: the Chief never asks (Lawrence 2026-10-20). Auto lets Claude Code's safety classifier judge each call; Manual (default) refuses each call Claude Code would ask about. The Chief host reads it at each turn start; a Chief's own chief engine set --mode picks within it, never wider.

help.text: How the Chief's own turns handle permissions. Bypass runs every command without asking. Auto lets a safety check decide each command. Manual refuses each change that would need approval. Applies from the next turn.
